An operation has completed.
For example, subscriptions that replay from the transaction log can
produce a completed acknowledgment to indicate when transaction log
replay has finished and further messages for the subscription are the
result of new publishes.

AMPS has processed the command.
Notice that, depending on the command, AMPS may not have executed
the command when this acknowledgment is produced.
AMPS has received the command, but has not yet processed it.

Statistics for the command.
This acknowledgment is typically produced after the command has fully
completed.
